name: tessera-bridge
description: Reports every Claude session (state, context, the account's limits, open questions) to the tessera_claude integration in Home Assistant, so Tessera screens show them all and answer questions

haUrl.title: Home Assistant URL
haUrl.description: Base URL of Home Assistant as this PC reaches it, without a trailing slash

haToken.title: Home Assistant token
haToken.description: A long-lived access token (HA profile → Security → Long-lived access tokens). Empty turns the bridge off.

instanceName.title: Computer name
instanceName.description: How this computer is named in the session list on the screens; empty for none.

sessionName.title: Session name
sessionName.description: A name for the sessions of this installation; empty takes the project folder's name.

permissionHints.title: Permission hints
permissionHints.description: on: a permission prompt in the app is shown on the screens as a hint (answered on the PC). off: no hint.

hintDelay.title: Permission hint delay
hintDelay.description: Seconds a permission ask has to stay open before the screen shows a hint. In the app's auto mode every call is reported as an ask first and most settle by themselves, so a longer delay (10 to 15) avoids false hints there.
